title: Igris AI Commander — Capstone Project
content: Igris AI Commander (Kaggle / Google AI Agents Intensive — Vibe Coding Capstone, Concierge Agents track). A Telegram-based personal AI agent orchestrator that manages Gmail summaries, job scouting, and approvals from a single control center. Engineered with a human-in-the-loop approval layer so sensitive or destructive actions like sending emails, applying to jobs, deleting, or archiving require explicit confirmation before running. Built in Node.js and TypeScript using Telegram Bot API, Gmail API, OAuth 2.0, Playwright browser automation, and a local Ollama gemma3:4b model running under PM2, structured into skills, specs, policies, tests, and eval folders. Repository: https://github.com/rameshio/igris-ai-commander-capstone.
